_meta.restaurant: Curry District, 11851 FM 423 Ste 200, Little Elm TX 75068
_meta.method: WebSearch snippets only. Every direct page fetch (currydistrict.net, allmenus, res-menu, wheree, singleplatform, menupix, sirved, zmenu, doordash, ubereats, restaurantguru, web.archive.org) was blocked by the egress proxy, and the session WebSearch budget (200) ran out after about 20 targeted queries. Nothing below was read from a live menu page. All values are second-hand aggregator snippets (AI-summarised search results).
_meta.confidenceKey: high = >=2 independent sources agree on item and price (none reached this bar for prices); medium = item corroborated by >=2 sources or one aggregator price consistent with an anchor value, price may still vary by platform; low = single unattributed snippet or conflicting prices. price:null means unknown or conflicting; the values actually seen are in priceNote.
_meta.extraKeys: priceNote (string) was added to items; it is not part of the minimal schema and can be ignored by consumers that only need name/description/price/diet/spice/tags/confidence/sources.

offers.lunch: No lunch buffet found in any snippet. DoorDash shows a 'Lunch Box' menu section; contents and price are not known. DoorDash also lists a 'Biryani's Combo Offer' marked Tuesday and Wednesday only. Meltivers (a third-party promotions page) lists a 'Wednesday Special Offer: Any 3 Biryanis $25.99'; it was seen in one snippet and the price was not cross-checked. Lunch service hours in data/business.json are 11:00 AM to 2:30 PM (3:00 PM Fri to Sun), not verified. No thali or lunch-combo pricing was found.
offers.catering: The official site has a catering page (currydistrict.net/catering.html); its content could not be read. Sulekha describes outdoor catering for special occasions plus pre-booked advance platters for large groups, customised to the client's taste, for baby showers, corporate events, surprise parties, housewarmings and birthdays. No party-tray sizes or prices were found. Sulekha gives (469) 200-5944 as the contact number. The family packs (see Rice) and the Weekend Family Pack are the only priced group-size items found.
offers.happyHour: Weekdays 4 to 7 PM, per the Atly listing (same as data/business.json). What is discounted was NOT found. Caution: dinner service in business.json resumes at 4:30 PM, so a 4 PM start looks inconsistent; treat the window as unverified. One snippet also says you can bring your own beer on weekends (unverified, low confidence). Do not show any happy-hour discount or alcohol claim.
offers.delivery: Delivery and pickup: Uber Eats, DoorDash (with a Caviar mirror and a legacy Postmates link) and Clover online ordering (curry-district-little-elm.cloveronline.com). The official site has a 'Door Delivery' page (currydistrict.net/doordelivery.html) that could not be read. Minimum order, delivery fee and service fee were not found. Delivery-app prices appear to run higher than the aggregator menu prices (for example Garlic Naan $3.49 vs $3.75), but this is an inference. Gift cards are listed on Giftly (a third-party gift-card page).
offers.other: Weekend Family Pack: weekend family-size biryani and pulav packs come with a free appetizer and dessert, chef's choice (official site: 'family pack options that include free appetizer and dessert'). DoorDash prices seen: Chicken 65 Biryani $47.79, Chicken Dum Biryani $47.79, Chicken 65 Pulav $42.99. The breakfast menu (Idly, Vada, Dosa, Puri) and the Indo-Chinese section are on the official site; not researched here. Possible sister location: the Instagram and Facebook handles say 'CurryDistrictFrisco', so some aggregator data (especially the conflicting dessert and lassi prices) may come from another location or an older menu.

notes: Method limits: WebFetch was blocked for every menu site, and the WebSearch budget ran out, so no price reached 'high'. All figures are AI-summarised search snippets, and the source page for several lists could not be pinned down (marked 'not individually attributable'). Biggest open questions: (1) current dessert prices ($2.99-$3.99 list vs $4.99-$5.99 list); (2) current lassi price ($2.99 / $3.99 / $4.99); (3) whether bread prices differ in-store vs delivery ($3.49 vs $3.75 Garlic Naan); (4) Bullet Naan and Paratha may belong to another restaurant's page; (5) happy-hour discounts, lunch box contents, catering price list, kids menu and fees were not found; (6) no soda, bottled-drink, salt lassi, rose lassi or cold-coffee evidence was found, so none were invented. Diet labels are inferred from the dish type, not stated by the restaurant, and ice cream, Apricot Delight, Bullet Naan and Paratha are marked unknown. Do not make halal, vegan or gluten-free claims. Descriptions tagged 'generic-description' are generic dish definitions, not the restaurant's own copy. An unattributed snippet claimed 'extra roti $1.00 add-on'; it came from results that included other restaurants, so it is excluded. For design mockups use the null prices as placeholders or omit prices, and add anything unresolved to docs/OPEN_QUESTIONS.md. Uber Eats lists the address as '11851 U.S. Army Sgt Enrique Mondragon Memorial Hwy', which appears to be the renamed FM 423. Suggested next step: call the restaurant or get the owners to send the current menu PDF to settle prices. Phone numbers seen: (469) 200-5944, (469) 200-5856, (972) 787-1320.
